questions.a: Upload the exam as an image, PDF or text. Select the student's profile (ADHD, dyslexia, etc.) and Adapto rewrites the questions with real adaptations: word banks, simplified instructions, reduced times and visual cues.

questions.q: Are the adaptations valid for educational inspection?
questions.a: Yes. Adapto follows the UDL framework, LOMLOE criteria and the BOE's NEAE standards. The report includes a UDL score (0-100), principle-by-principle analysis and a downloadable PDF support sheet.

questions.q: Do I need an education background to use it?
questions.a: Not at all. You just specify the grade, subject and type of need. Adapto handles the rest using AI trained on current Spanish educational regulations.
PDF, image (JPG/PNG) or direct text. You can paste the full exam or upload a photo from your phone.
